relations.subject: Jacqueline Ilyse Stone
relations.role: emeritus professor of Japanese religion in the department of religion
relations.evidence: Jacqueline Ilyse Stone (born June 30, 1949) is an emeritus professor of Japanese religion in the department of religion at Princeton University [...] She taught at Princeton from 1990 until her retirement on July 1, 2019.

relations.subject: Jacqueline Ilyse Stone
relations.evidence: Stone earned a B.A. in Japanese and English from San Francisco State University in 1974.
